description: This file contains the implementation of the ReCaptchaService class, which handles verification of ReCaptcha responses by communicating with Google's ReCaptcha API, including methods for response validation, error reporting, and HTTP request handling.

classes.name: ReCaptchaService
classes.description: A service class responsible for verifying ReCaptcha responses by interacting with Google's ReCaptcha API, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: VerifyCaptchaResponseAsync
methods.description: Verifies the ReCaptcha response string by checking if it is non-empty, configuration exists, and calling VerifyAsync.

methods.name: ValidateCaptchaAsync
methods.description: Validates the captcha in the current HTTP request, retrieves the response token from headers or form, and reports errors if validation fails.

methods.name: VerifyAsync
methods.description: Sends the response token to Google's ReCaptcha API to verify its validity, handling HTTP request and response parsing.
